description: This PHP class 'Upgrade7' is part of the OpenCart installation upgrade process. It primarily performs data migration by converting serialized PHP data stored in the database to JSON format for modules, handling potential exceptions, and preparing the response JSON for upgrade status and next steps.

classes.name: Upgrade7
classes.description: A controller class responsible for upgrading old Opencart versions by converting serialized data to JSON during the upgrade process.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method invoked for the upgrade step; performs the data fix from serialized PHP to JSON and prepares the JSON response.
